layout_sources: https://github.com/firefly-iii/import-configurations/blob/main/gb/barclays/default.json (comma, header row, d/m/Y; Number, Date, Account, Amount, Subcategory, Memo)

https://github.com/kaartiik/finance-tracker/tree/main/uploads (Barclays exports uploaded to an app, Dec 2024 - Jan 2025: LF, leading tab on Number from the 2nd row, memo = 22-char payee + TAB + reference + TAB, trailing tab-only line)
https://github.com/awhitwam/whit-lend/blob/main/csv%20examples/bank%20csv/barclays.csv (2024 export re-saved by a tool: same Subcategory words, memo tabs, unquoted comma in a memo)
https://github.com/Breakthru/splitbills/blob/master/finance/barclays.py (newest first: prints in reverse; reads latin_1)
notes: Newest first, DD/MM/YYYY, one signed Amount with two decimals and no thousands mark, no balance column, no currency named. Account is "sort-code account-number". Number is 0 except a direct debit reference. Memo is the payee padded to 22 characters (then any location), a TAB, the reference/type code (BCC card, CPM contactless, BDC, DDR, BGC, FT), and a trailing TAB; that trailing tab makes every row after the first start with a TAB in Number, and the file ends with a line holding a single TAB. Memos are not quoted, so a payee with a comma ("EXAMPLE CLOUD, INC.") spills into a 7th field. LF line endings as seen in the 2024-25 exports (not certain: could have been normalised). ASCII.
